# Prospect

Prospect is building AI-native portfolio intelligence and decision infrastructure for systematic investment teams, including systematic hedge funds, quant teams, asset managers and proprietary trading firms.

Canonical site: https://prospectpartnership.co.uk/
Company: Prospect Partnership Ltd
Founder: Fred Boxer
Contact: founder@prospectpartnership.co.uk

Prospect is pre-product and building V1. Initial deployments are intended as analytics and decision support; customers retain discretion over capital deployment.
